reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the full exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; checked hair, brows, spectacles, moustache, single pipe-occupied mouth, clothing and collar, verified the parent/receipt/evidence/generation bindings, and independently recomputed RGB identity and BILINEAR source-alpha equality with read-only Python.

hair_features.reason: Short dark temple hair and sideburn, dark eyebrows and a large curled handlebar moustache remain; the chin is smooth without a beard, and exactly one mouth is closed on the pipe.

collar_fit.reason: The rounded chin meets a short broad shirt/coat collar transition without a neck stalk, pinching, floating cloth or an added cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The final derivative retains the approved yellow compact mascot with green-ringed black eyes, round thin spectacles, one dark handlebar moustache and one curved pipe projecting image right. The tan/brown fedora retains its broad black ribbon and brim; the image-right three-quarter pose and directional lighting remain. The dark brown overcoat retains broad raised lapels, cream pointed shirt collar and dark tie. The full dark brown/charcoal painted backing keeps its gradient and low-key vignette, without a frame, note, matte or invented replacement studio. White/cyan viewing shows solid clothing and backing with no visible holes or lost background.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the repaired RGBA for production. Independent pixel verification confirms RGB is unchanged from the approved parent and alpha exactly matches the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. Source and returned extrema are [255,255], and all source, resized and output corners are 255. Full white/cyan/alpha inspection confirms an intact opaque rectangular backing without interior holes or an exterior halo.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine pipe grain and the exact coat-collar stitching cannot be resolved reliably at 156x210. Their major visible shapes, positions and counts were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
